assets.title: A quiet home
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a dedicated wide landscape 16:9 editorial photograph for Aurelio's interactive website section 'A finish for every room', scene 'A quiet home', finish 'Antique brass'. Create a tranquil sunlit living room in a thoughtfully designed home, centered on a handcrafted aged brass dome table lamp on a low walnut side table and an elegant matching antique brass wall sconce. A small aged brass bowl rests nearby. Include an ivory linen sofa, limewashed warm cream walls, natural stone flooring and a subtle muted forest-green cushion, with soft curtains and a glimpse of foliage. The brass must look convincingly antiqued: mellow brown-gold patina, darker recesses, softly burnished edges and a low satin glow, never mirror-polished or vivid yellow. Professional architectural interiors photography, natural material imperfections, softly directional afternoon daylight, believable shadows, refined quiet styling without clutter. Composition: landscape 16:9, room at human eye level, brass lamp and sconce large enough to read on a website, main subjects within the central 70% with breathing room around edges. Cohesive luxury Moradabad metal-and-wood atelier campaign in warm brass, walnut, limestone and muted emerald. Photography, not CGI. No people, text, letters, logos, watermarks, collage, borders, diagrams or website interface.

assets.title: A boutique hotel
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a dedicated wide landscape 16:9 editorial photograph for Aurelio's interactive website section 'A finish for every room', scene 'A boutique hotel', finish 'Polished brass'. Create an intimate luxury boutique hotel lounge with beautifully handcrafted polished brass furniture and lighting. Hero subjects: a low circular polished brass coffee table with a clean sculptural cylindrical base and a slender brass-framed walnut console, accompanied by elegant cream upholstered seating with polished brass legs and two polished brass pendant lights. Deep muted emerald paneling, walnut details, travertine floor, fresh sculptural branches and tall windows establish a warm welcoming interior. The brass finish is visibly smooth and highly polished with crisp coherent reflections and warm gold highlights, without looking chrome, orange or plasticky. assets.title: A gathered table
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a dedicated wide landscape 16:9 editorial photograph for Aurelio's interactive website section 'A finish for every room', scene 'A gathered table', finish 'Hammered brass & copper'. Create a welcoming dining table set for a small gathering on a shaded garden terrace. The hero is a thoughtful collection of handcrafted hammered metal serveware: a generous shallow hammered brass serving bowl with fruit, a hammered copper water pitcher with a smoothly formed sturdy handle, a second smaller hammered copper bowl, and a brass tray holding two matching metal tumblers. The metal surfaces must have visibly hand-hammered small irregular dimples, honest natural reflections, warm ochre-gold brass distinct from reddish rose copper, subtle patina and realistic rolled rims. Arrange the pieces prominently on a walnut table with a casually laid ivory linen runner, simple ivory ceramic plates and muted green linen napkins; soft leafy greenery and a cream plaster wall in the background. Elegant but lived-in gathering, not a crowded banquet or a retail display. Wide landscape 16:9, three-quarter camera view slightly above table height, hero serveware in the central 70% with ample room around edges, texture clearly legible at website size. Soft dappled late afternoon daylight, tactile authentic photography, understated luxury matching an Aurelio Moradabad metal-and-wood atelier campaign. No people, hands, labels, words, logos, watermark, collage, borders or website interface.
